mapper.select: SELECT id, emp_no, password, name, email, role, enabled, fail_count, locked_until, created_at, last_login_at FROM users WHERE emp_no = #{empNo}
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM users WHERE emp_no = #{empNo}
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (emp_no, password, name, email, role, enabled, fail_count, created_at) VALUES (#{empNo}, #{password}, #{name}, #{email}, 'ROLE_USER', 1, 0, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET fail_count = fail_count + 1 WHERE emp_no = #{empNo}
UPDATE users SET locked_until = #{lockedUntil} WHERE emp_no = #{empNo}
